blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The sole tracked sBOLD deployment is Ethereum 0x50bd66d59911f5e086ec87ae43c811e0d059dd11, accounting for 100% of circulating supply in the 2026-10-19 supply data. At Ethereum mainnet block 26224795 (2026-10-19T06:21:11+00:00), owner() returned 0x2df68ea583b8394a8cc71eebcd4fa7c6746027d5 and paused() returned false. Exact-match verified sBold/BaseSBold source shows a direct, non-proxy deployment: the nonzero owner can call pause()/unpause(), and whenNotPaused gates deposit, mint, redeem, withdraw, and swap. Because the token’s own redeem/withdraw exits can be globally paused for existing holders, this is direct Possible under the global-pause rule of the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md), even though the pause is not currently engaged. Ordinary inherited OpenZeppelin ERC20 transfer/transferFrom paths remain unrestricted: no selective holder blacklist, address freeze, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, allowlist, or privileged-transfer hook was found. The independently assessed BOLD parent has no qualifying holder-freeze surface; 100% of the reserve composition is BOLD deployed into Liquity V2 Stability Pools, with 0% qualifying issuer/custodian exposure. Neither the parent nor the reserve test overrides the higher-priority direct Possible control. Conclusion: Possible, not No; no active holder-targeted Yes control is asserted.

oracleRisk.summary: sBOLD is an ERC-4626 allocator over Liquity V2 Stability Pools and has no borrower-owned debt positions or local collateral liquidation thresholds. Its required BOLD parent carries the separately reviewed WETH, wstETH, and rETH oracle and liquidation branches.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sBOLD's ERC-4626 accounting values Stability Pool assets per share, and its oracle registry prices liquidation gains for swaps back to BOLD. Those exchange-rate and swap valuations are price-sensitive top-level authorities; the wrapper originates no borrower debt and has no local collateral-ratio liquidation branches.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sBOLD is a K3 Capital wrapper deployed only on Ethereum in the registry. No material bridge route was resolved for the wrapper, so it is reviewed as single-chain/native for bridge-route scoring.
